claim.claim-text: 1. A sleeveless urinary catheter assembly comprising:

a urinary catheter; and a protective tip received on the urinary catheter and comprising a proximal piece and a distal piece, wherein the distal piece is separate from or detachably connected to the proximal piece.
2. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 1, wherein

the proximal piece of the protective tip is detachably connected to the distal piece prior to use, and a distal end of the proximal piece includes a first formation configured to mate with a second formation of a proximal end of the distal piece when the proximal piece is connected to the distal piece.
3. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 2, wherein
the first formation is configured as an outwardly facing, generally annular rib, and the second formation is configured as an inwardly facing, generally annular channel or groove.

4. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of claims 2-3, wherein one or both of the proximal piece and the distal piece is configured to be deformed so as to cause the first formation to dissociate from the second formation.
5. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 2, wherein the first and second formations are configured as mating screw threads.
6. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of claims 2-5, wherein the proximal piece and the distal piece are configured to be reconnected after being disconnected.
7. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of claims 2-5, wherein the proximal piece and the distal piece are configured to not be reconnected after being disconnected.
8. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the distal piece of the protective tip is associated with a distal end of the urinary catheter prior to use.
9. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 8, wherein
the distal end of the urinary catheter includes a funnel, and the distal piece of the protective tip is detachably connected to the funnel prior to use.
10. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of claims 8-9, wherein

the proximal piece of the protective tip is detachably connected to the distal piece prior to use, the proximal and distal pieces of the protective tip are movable along the urinary catheter from the distal end of the urinary catheter to a proximal end of the urinary catheter, and the distal piece is configured to be detached from the proximal piece when the proximal piece has been moved to the proximal end of the urinary catheter.
11. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of any one of claims 1-7, wherein the proximal piece is associated with a proximal end of the urinary catheter prior to use.

12. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 1, wherein the proximal piece of the protective tip is separate from the distal piece and associated with a proximal end of the urinary catheter prior to use.
13. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 12, wherein the distal piece is associated with a distal end of the urinary catheter prior to use.
14. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 13, wherein
the distal end of the urinary catheter includes a funnel, and the distal piece of the protective tip is detachably connected to the funnel prior to use.
15. The sleeveless urinary catheter assembly of claim 12, wherein

the urinary catheter extends between a distal end and the proximal end, and the distal piece of the protective tip is positioned between the proximal and distal ends of the urinary catheter prior to use.
